notes.title: Update 6: Shadows of the Past
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/fede6cb1c440c39a562c27f632bc7a9e9e60bc6a.png"][/img][/p][p]A faint radio signal from a long forgotten facility could save the future of civilization. But to get there, brave Survivors will have to venture deep into the deadly heart of the old world.[/p][p]The Settlers will need to develop new technologies, fight back a growing zombie threat and expand civilization to secure their fate…[/p][p]It's an all new, major expansion for the game![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Campaign[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/0ca9d257308ca48be0e7a02a57b000f7ebc25b4d.png"][/img][/p][p]Establish Settlements across 10 new levels and discover what lies deep in the shadows of the old world.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Buildings: Outposts, Logistics Posts & Forts[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/3c6cebd04ace65117f67c7f26765febfbff5f238.png"][/img][/p][p]Construct Outposts to assist with production and combat, then specialise them further into Logistics Posts or Forts.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Infested Borders[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/7466224674d78a3a08e7f4f40dbaac1a625ef9b2.png"][/img][/p][p]Fight back against distant infestations plaguing the region. Zombies will be continually drawn towards your Settlements![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Population & Technology[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/dd6859f0f27a68c815c809d74d6861aa28c70038.png"][/img][/p][p]Expand your Settlements even further with new services and higher level production buildings.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Changelog[/b][/h2][list][*][p]New Campaign: Discover a forgotten research lab amidst the ruins in 10 new Levels[/p][/*][*][p]Infested Borders: Fight back against distant infestations plaguing the region[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded Civilization: Use Outposts to boost your settlement as well as new buildings, Population and Tech Levels[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Shadows of the Past Campaign (10 new levels)[/p][/*][*][p]New Buildings - Upgradable Outpost: Benefit from improved resource production and combat strength, further specialise the Outpost with Logistics or Fort upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Infested Borders: Zombies will be continually drawn towards your Settlements![/p][/*][*][p]New Rewards: All new rewards from the Shadows of the Past Campaign[/p][/*][*][p]New Population & Technology Levels: Upgrade to Population 14 and Technology 7[/p][/*][*][p]Added Ingenuity Soundtrack to campaign rotation[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Buildings built further from the Settlement now cost slightly more Stamina[/p][/*][*][p]Herb Gardens now require Stone to build from Level 3[/p][/*][*][p]Lumberyards now require Stone to Build from Level 6[/p][/*][*][p]Deer, Cow, and Sheep Material buildings now require Wood to build[/p][/*][*][p]Stone Quarries cost more Wood and less Stamina to build[/p][/*][*][p]High-level production buildings cost increasing amounts of Wood and Stone[/p][/*][*][p]Festivals now improve Celebration Chance[/p][/*][*][p]Celebrations now increase Final Score[/p][/*][*][p]Escape Hatch mode no longer reduces Final Score[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Disable Tips: You can now disable Tip Popups in game settings. Let us know how you find this feature and if there are other popups we should be labelling as Tips![/p][/*][*][p]When Areas are under attack, building health bars become larger[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes [/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where the Context Menu would not correctly update initial priorities [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Maintain X Resource" objective would complete when you loaded the game[/p][/*][*][p]Stability improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2][p]We've got lots more coming soon for After Inc: Revival. Check out our Roadmap! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/e1f7cfb9e5a32444f5e60f020bfab5a90fb236d6.png"][/img][/p][p]But also be sure to let us know what you'd like to see in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3337140/discussions/"]forums[/url], on [url="https://discord.com/invite/ndemic"]discord[/url], and on our [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/AfterInc/"]reddit[/url].[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update 5 - Looming Shadows
notes.content:
[p]In our fifth major update, we've made some big changes to give you more options as you rebuild the world, implement more satisfying combat and lay the groundwork for the Shadows of the Past campaign.[/p][p][/p][h3]Zombies & Combat[/h3][p]We've adjusted Zombie awakenings to be more predictable, now based on your actions and how much attention you've brought to your settlement. Settlement size and weather also factor in, so keep an eye out![/p][p]Fighters will now consume resources when in unclaimed zones, are stronger when taunting, and the Reinforce ability is always available. [/p][p][/p][h3]
Morale - Celebrations[/h3][p]To reward keeping your Morale high, we've added Celebrations. You'll get a gift of Stamina and a reduction of Impatience (based on Settlement Size). The happier your people are, the more likely they'll celebrate.[/p][p]High morale now also improves your Population Growth and Fighter Strength.[/p][p][/p][h3]Population[/h3][p]Once you get to higher populations, Demands will be more reasonable, baseline population growth speed will be reduced, and Morale will have a greater impact on Population Growth.[/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog[/h3][p]New Features[/p][list][*][p]Added Celebration mechanic. Chance to get Celebration bubbles when morale >100% (capped by population)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Zombie Awareness mechanic. Increased by Claiming/Fighter movement as well as Settlement activity and Weather. Makes zombies more likely to wake and makes zombies join existing fights more quickly. Zombies attacking into an existing fight will make things worse based on Awareness[/p][/*][*][p]Added Gluttons expedition modifier[/p][/*][*][p]Added Stretched Supply Chains expedition modifier[/p][/*][*][p]Added High Maintenance expedition modifier[/p][/*][*][p]Added Warrior Ethos expedition modifier[/p][/*][/list][p]Balance Changes[/p][list][*][p]Population 6 onwards: Population demands made more reasonable[/p][/*][*][p]Population 6 onwards: Baseline Population Growth Speed reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Population 6 onwards: Morale has a greater impact on Population Growth[/p][/*][*][p]+Population Trait boosted[/p][/*][*][p]+Morale Trait boosted[/p][/*][*][p]Fighters now consume Water, Food, and Fuel when in unclaimed areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Shrine service - now needed 1 population later. Going from 10 to 11 population will no longer result in such a big morale drop[/p][/*][*][p]Increased impact of Reanimation modifier[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced randomness of Reanimation [/p][/*][/list][p]Quality of Life[/p][list][*][p]Updated building action logic to always remain above Storage and Scavenge actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Leader Bubbles artwork[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Enemy Warning Icon artwork[/p][/*][*][p]Fighters will prepare for battle when taunting - boosting their strength[/p][/*][*][p]Fighters will try to be quiet when moving near zombies (but will move slower). Typically a fighter will never wake up a group of zombies if this is your first time in contact with them.[/p][/*][*][p]A fighter retreating now results in a lingering combat penalty for a while in that area (other fighters are scared to go there)[/p][/*][*][p]Reinforce is now introduced in level 5, and available at game start after that.[/p][p]Taunt and Reinforce actions are now available in early campaign missions if their introduction levels (Level 4 and level 5) have been beaten.[/p][/*][*][p]Festivals now boost population growth speed[/p][/*][*][p]Research and Fighter training now faster with higher populations[/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixes for Morale icons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of visual issues with map bubbles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Rain may not start after a Drought[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Goals could have too high a threshold in Expeditions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Zombies would keep moving to different area if Fighter attacking them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Zombies might be killed too quickly when entering an area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Goal target thresholds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]What's Next?[/h3][p]We're making progress on a brand new campaign: Shadows of the Past: New levels, new zombie mechanics and a new tech level! Not to mention find out what happens next in the Abandoned Kingdom.[/p][p]Be sure to leave us a review if you're enjoying the game! or join our [u]Discord[/u] to chat with us, try exclusive betas and swap tactics on how to rebuild the world.[/p]

notes.title: Update 4 - Build Cancelling
notes.content: [p]Our fourth update lets you undo your mistakes.[/p][p]This was a very popular request from players, you wanted to change your builds on the fly. Thanks to everyone for your feedback and especially those who voted in our development poll so far. [/p][p]FYI - the game has now been out for more than a month! This is our fourth major update (+5 smaller patches). We are working at full speed and you can read more about what we are working on at the end of this post.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/cdd7d743f0652e0d94ac3486a2cf62aa4a670f21.png"][/img][/p][h2]Build Cancelling[/h2][p]We've all been there, you line up a series of important building orders, but then the Zombies attack! You need that Stamina to get a Fighter out there immediately. In the past, you'd have to sit with your choices. But not anymore![/p][p]Go to an in-progress construction. If it's yellow, then you can click to cancel it and get a full refund of your Stamina and Resources. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/6e11bff0d9372ef957bcbaad2c00d32be4d5a803.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/f9eb45123dbaaf0d8b833f79d0b56dd18e26a6ce.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We're excited to see how this changes up your building and rebuilding of civilization. [/p][p][/p][h3]Full Changelog[/h3][p][b]New Features & Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Build Cancelling - If the construction bar is yellow, click it and have the option to cancel your construction for a full refund![/p][/*][*][p]Added Fuel Reserves Depleted Decision[/p][/*][*][p]Added Water Reserves Depleted Decision [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added hover animation to the 'show all resources' button in the top left of the in game UI[/p][/*][*][p]Improved text wrapping in Decision descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]UI polish and improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where Population Traits and Leader select screen would change when re-entering with Escape Hatch mode enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the game would not paused during the "Not Enough Resource" popup when triggered from the  Right-Click Context Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where some Maintain Morale objectives could not be completed with the Stand Together cheat enabled[/p][/*][/list][h3]What's Next?[/h3][p]We're making progress on a brand new campaign: Shadows of the Past: New levels, new zombie mechanics and a new tech level! Not to mention find out what happens next in the Abandoned Kingdom.[/p][p]Be sure to leave us a review if you're enjoying the game! or join our [url="https://discord.gg/ndemic"][u]Discord[/u][/url] to chat with us, try exclusive betas and swap tactics on how to rebuild the world.[/p]

notes.title: Update 3: Direct Control
notes.content:
[p]Our third update is all about power and control by using the right click mouse button! Experienced players can now control exactly where new buildings are constructed. It also provides another way to quickly navigate around the UI (along with the existing hot keys) [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone for your feedback and especially those who voted in our development poll so far. More information on what other things we are working on below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Direct Control[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/80c9e87bf19cf890d1f5d232ac631f198e0f629a.png"][/img][/p][p]Our new update includes a simple but powerful tool, right click on any Area and you'll be able to perform a variety of options:[/p][list][*][p]Strategically choose your Resource Building locations. Do you want to build cheaply - but close to zombies - or prioritize building in a secure Areas or closer to the Settlement?[/p][/*][*][p]Build housing and services in your settlement without having to open the Settlement menu[/p][/*][*][p]Easily take actions like Explore or Claim Areas without having to move your mouse or using hotkeys[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/38fd2b45f3be48cd58f3939284386e368248fa40.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Full Changelog[/h3][p]New Features[/p][list][*][p]Added 'Direct Control' right-click an Area feature[/p][/*][*][p]Added 'Reset Settings' option[/p][list][*][p]Helpful if you've accidentally selected and approved the wrong resolution![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Quality of Life[/p][list][*][p]Added Score explanation to the end screen[/p][/*][*][p]Corner numeral icons updated to be more legible[/p][/*][*][p]Significant Localisation pass on Simplified Chinese by translation team[/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Improved text positioning in many areas of the UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the settlement name not updating for events after the frog collecting decision[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where free buildings wouldn't show a "0" cost[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the invert scrolling option to default to "Off"[/p][/*][/list][h3]What's Next?[/h3][p]The work continues on the brand new campaign Shadows of the Past, adding new game mechanics and a lot more levels.[/p][p]
Be sure to leave us a review if you're enjoying the game! or join our [url="https://discord.gg/ndemic"][u]Discord[/u][/url] to chat with us, try exclusive betas and swap tactics on how to rebuild the world.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2: Escape Hatch
notes.content:
[p]Two weeks after launch, our second major update smashes open the emergency exit and escapes onto Steam - adding a whole new way to replay campaigns…[/p][p][/p][p]This was a very popular request from players who wanted to be able to replay campaign maps without knowing exactly where everything is. Thanks to everyone for your feedback and especially those who voted in our development poll so far. [/p][p][/p][p]FYI - the game has now been out for 2 weeks. This is our second major update (+3 smaller patches). We are working at full speed and you can read more about what we are working on at the end of this post.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/e689fd6c4a4d13155fec1f1654880bd400fab172.png"][/img][/p][h2]Escape Hatch[/h2][p]After completing a Campaign level, a new option will open up: the Escape Hatch mode.[/p][p][/p][p]Enabling it lets Survivors use a new exit to leave the bunker! Starting location, terrain and enemies are reshuffled so you don't know exactly what is out there...[/p][p][/p][p]Can you still build a thriving settlement if you emerged on the other side of the region? What if meat was scarce? Or forests far away?[/p][p][/p][p]It's a brand new challenge every time with some special surprises.[/p][p][/p][h3]Full Changelog[/h3][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Escape Hatch Mode[/p][list][*][p]Developer note - a player requested feature to improve replayability of the campaign levels[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Expeditions will now leave different colour and size icons on the Abandoned Kingdom map to reflect what difficulty they were beaten on.[/p][list][*][p]Developer note: An extra way to reward players for beating expeditions and recognise the difficulty level - the world map becomes a bit like a trophy cabinet![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New completed expedition icons added to the pool including special ones for Mega Brutal[/p][/*][*][p]The game will now warn you if building housing that will need new Services researched. [/p][list][*][p]Developer note: Another player requested feature so players know if they are in danger of growing too fast and encountering morale issues. This doesn’t apply on Mega Brutal.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Difficulty and Region Name to the settlement screen Overview panel[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the size of completed Expedition score boxes[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted padding of World Map for different screens[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the fitting of ranking stars on level select to better align with text [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fix for camera zoom when selecting a Campaign whilst already having a Level selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with 'Growth Spurt' achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed levelled building shadows appearing strange[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with initial Reward Points not being earned in Extra Expeditions if you didn’t have existing rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential reward bug when saving and loading an Expedition[/p][/*][/list][h3]What's Next?[/h3][p]We're hard at work on a brand new campaign Shadows of the Past which adds new game mechanics and a lot more levels. [/p][p]At the same time, we are working on various other features including a control scheme upgrade that lets people use right click to build things in specific areas. More news on all of this soon and we will adjust plans in response to player feedback as always :)[/p][p]
Be sure to leave us a review if you're enjoying the game! or join our [u][url="https://discord.gg/ndemic"]Discord[/url][/u] to chat with us, try exclusive betas and swap tactics on how to rebuild the world.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update 1: Extra Expeditions
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/9a818519ac2d555ea0450cdb8d4ed5b513376670.png"][/img][/p][p]The first update for After Inc: Revival is here - adding more expeditions, Mac support, bugfixes and a number of quality of life enhancements.[/p][h3]
Steam Reviews: Your Feedback Matters[/h3][p]It’s been great getting so much feedback from players about what you want to see in the game - I’ve been reading all the forum posts and Steam reviews. Please keep sharing your thoughts so I know what to focus on for upcoming updates.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the top requests has been from people who have beaten both campaigns and want to be able to send out more expeditions than just the normal daily ones. We’ve been ‘inspired’ by the Personal Trainer leader in game and as a result, have updated the game with the new Extra Expeditions feature in record time![/p][p][/p][h3]Extra Expeditions[/h3][p]You can now send out 30 extra expeditions if you’ve completed the Daily Expeditions. These challenges are seeded and the same for everyone no matter when you play them so no need to rush.[/p][p]
Providing you with a variety of danger, ambition and interesting opportunities, these bonus Expeditions will keep your civilization on its toes while it expands into the unknown.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Full Changelog[/b][/h3][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Mac Support:[/b] We're excited to announce that the game now officially supports Mac![/p][/*][*][p][b]Extra Expeditions:[/b] A new "Extra Expeditions" feature has been added, giving you more opportunities for exploration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Development Poll:[/b] Vote on what features you want prioritised in future updates[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p][b]Expedition Bubble Size:[/b] The size of expedition bubbles has been shrunk for a cleaner look.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Random Level Animation:[/b] We've adjusted the animation duration between idle and selected states for random levels on the world map, making transitions smoother.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leader Selection Info Popups:[/b] You'll now find helpful info popups on the leader selection screens.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]CJK Improvements:[/b] CJK text improvements now address a small lag that appeared when opening a screen for the first time.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]What's Next?[/h3][p]We're working hard on future updates. You can check out our roadmap to see our plans and also vote in the in game poll to let us know what you think we should be prioritising![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/d5c43b7540bf87ef3e569a03bb2320f7b2dec47d.png"][/img][/p][p]Be sure to leave us a review if you're enjoying the game! or join our Discord to chat with us, try exclusive betas and swap tactics on how to rebuild the world.[/p][p]
Ndemic Creations Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Launch Hotfix 3
notes.content: [p]We have the first big update coming later this week with Extra Expeditions (will be on open beta channel soon) but in the mean time, here are a few fixes to address feedback from players.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Leader Selection Warning: The leader selection warning on expeditions has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Micromanagement Achievement: Conditions for unlocking the Micromanagement achievement have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Quality of Life[/h2][list][*][p]Leader Selection & Survivor Recommendations: Starting leader selection and survivor recommendation popup conditions have been adjusted to only fire when suitable[/p][/*][*][p]Impatience Authority Floor: Impatience can no longer reduce your Authority below 5 on Casual, 4 on Normal, and 1 on Brutal difficulties. (previously was 1 on Casual and Normal). Interested to see how players find this - quite a big change but should smooth the difficulty curve between normal and brutal a bit)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Launch Hotfix 2
notes.content: [p]This update adds in a feature requested by quite a few players as well as some fixes / changes to ensure people don't play at a higher difficulty than they expect.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Factory Reset Button:[/b] A new "Factory Reset" button has been added to the settings screen. You can use this to wipe your progress if you want. BE CAREFUL![/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p][b]Leader Selection Adjustments:[/b] More challenging leaders have been moved out of the initial selection pools in early levels (that haven't been beaten).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localisation Review Popup:[/b] A localisation review popup will now be displayed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Leader Warning Popup:[/b] A warning popup now appears when selecting a more challenging leader in the initial levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various translation improvements[/b] - thanks to the community for all the feedback. Your suggestions on crowdin are being added every update![/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Garden Event Soft Lock:[/b] Fixed an issue where players could get soft-locked by not having enough resources in the "New Garden" event.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Launch Hotfix 1
notes.content: [h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p][b]Housing Warning Popup:[/b] Players on higher difficulty are growing their settlements too fast which causes them to lose control. The [b]housing warning popup[/b] now includes more info and stays visible at Brutal difficulty until level 5 to help warn against this..[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early Access to Campaigns & Expeditions:[/b] You can now access the [b]second campaign and daily expeditions[/b] before finishing the Survival Campaign, offering more ways to play sooner![/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved level display UI:[/b] We have seen some confusion about how many levels there are in the game. We now clearly show there are 18 levels in various places.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mac[/b]: The game is still not officially available for Mac, but people who are playing unofficially will now be able to access latest version. [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Steam Leaderboards Fix:[/b] Remaining [b]Leaderboards[/b] should now correctly appear on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resource Sidebar Update:[/b] The [b]resource sidebar items[/b] will now update correctly when you buy technologies in the settlement screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Random Level and Region Placement:[/b] We've adjusted the positions of [b]random levels and regions[/b] around the Survival Campaign and on the world map to prevent them from clashing with campaign pins.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Campaign Title Styling:[/b] [b]Campaign titles[/b] on the world map now have updated styling.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quitting Game Crash Fix:[/b] An issue causing a crash when [b]quitting the game[/b] has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Decision Bubbles Fix:[/b] [b]Decision bubbles[/b] should no longer visually pause.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Soldier Reinforcement Crash Fix:[/b] A crash that occurred when [b]reinforcing already dead soldiers[/b] has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Minor Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Widget Shadow Mask Sorting:[/b] The sorting method for [b]widget shadow masks[/b] has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Desktop Icon Resolution:[/b] The [b]desktop icon's resolution[/b] has been improved for a sharper look.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Preparing for launch - update 3
notes.content: [p]After Inc. was one of the most popular games in Steam Next fest and the game is nearly ready to release! This update applies to the main game (18885801) and demo (18885644)[/p][p][/p][h2]Latest Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]Stamina Bar Fix:[/b] The stamina bar will no longer freeze midway if stamina gets too high; it will now always pay out correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Soldier Training UI Adjustment:[/b] The soldier training UI element has been moved down to prevent it from clashing with left-side resources in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leader Select Screen Fix:[/b] The leader select screen will now correctly disappear when going back.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Modifier Icon Fix:[/b] Issues with map modifier icons not showing correctly have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Goal Bar Formatting Fix:[/b] A fix has been implemented for goal bar formatting in some languages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Japanese and Korean Title Treatments:[/b] Title treatments for Japanese and Korean languages have been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New music added[/b] (Beats of Progress)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Preparing for launch - update 2
notes.content: [p]The game is nearly ready to release and we are hard at work addressing feedback from the tens of thousands of people currently playing the demo! This update applies to the main game (18844352) and demo (18844244)[/p][list][*][p][b]Welcome Message for Full Version:[/b] Demo players will now see a greeting when moving to the full game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save File Compatibility:[/b] You can no longer open full version saves in the demo, which prevents crashes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resource Display:[/b] The numbers for resources on the left side of the screen (when "show all" is active) are now more opaque for better visibility.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Text Style Adjustments:[/b] We've adjusted the styles and materials for red, green, and orange feature text to improve their appearance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoother Menu Transitions:[/b] The main menu now has a sliding transition with the cross-fade effect removed, making it less jarring.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Advanced Soldier Display Fix:[/b] The advanced soldier asset now displays correctly, even when below max health.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cheat Select Screen Fix:[/b] Alpha transitions should no longer break the cheat select screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clickable Map Center:[/b] The center bottom of the map is now clickable again.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Rich Presence:[/b] Steam Rich Presence is now available in all languages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Windmill Visibility:[/b] Windmill fans now draw over background trees, ensuring they're always visible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various Crashes Fixed:[/b] Several issues causing crashes have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Authority Screen Color Fix:[/b] A bug causing victory colors not to load on the authority screen has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Windmill Animation Pause:[/b] Windmill fans now pause correctly with game controls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Random Level Recalibration:[/b] Random level positions have been recalibrated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement Language Corrected:[/b] Corrections have been made to achievement language.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist prompt[/b]: Pop up fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various Translation Improvements:[/b] You'll find a range of improvements across various translations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The 'Preparing for launch' update
notes.content: [p]The game is nearly ready to release and we are hard at work addressing feedback from the tens of thousands of people currently playing the demo! This update applies to the main game and demo.[/p][p][/p][h1]Key Changes[/h1][list][*][p][b]New Resource Display:[/b] We've added a button to show all resources, and the left side of the screen now displays the quantity of each resource.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Progress Bars:[/b] The height of the population and stamina progress bars has been increased for better visibility.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Left Shift Key Fix:[/b] The left shift key should now correctly cycle through [b]resources[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early Wood Bar Tutorial Fix:[/b] An issue with the early wood bar revealing too soon in the tutorial has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Rich Presence:[/b] We've added Steam Rich Presence text.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio Rebalance & Enhanced Sounds:[/b] Default music and SFX audio have been rebalanced, and button click sounds are now enhanced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stamina UI Update:[/b] The stamina UI will now update when you pop housing bubbles.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Other Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]CJK and Thai Character Styling:[/b] Styling for CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) and Thai characters has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]News Carousel Images:[/b] Images for Plague Inc and Rebel Inc on the news carousel now use the correct icons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settlement Naming Keybind:[/b] The back button keybind is now disabled when you're typing in the settlement name field.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keybind Screen Highlight Fix:[/b] Alternate key buttons on the keybind screen now highlight correctly when clicked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shadow Layering Fix:[/b] We've implemented a fix to ensure shadow layering works properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quarry Shadows:[/b] Quarry shadow shapes have been set.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ruined Coal Mine Images:[/b] Ruined coal mine images have been lightened.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save File Size Reduction:[/b] The save file size has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crater Images:[/b] Crater images have been unsharpened.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ruined Settlement Size Fix:[/b] The size of ruined settlements has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Modifier Icons:[/b] Issues with map modifiers showing the wrong icon in the main menu have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Modifier Colors:[/b] Selected state colors for map modifiers have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Herb Farm Shadows:[/b] Herb farm shadow shapes have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Windmill Animation:[/b] Windmill animation should now be less jerky.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settlement Button Layout Fix:[/b] The layout of the settlement button will no longer break if the text for patience runs too long.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Decision Outcome Selection Fix:[/b] Another fix has been implemented for selecting multiple decision outcomes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resource Side Bar:[/b] The [b]resource side bar[/b] now shows total/deficit resources, and hides the value when the bar is hidden.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Serialized Sheet Buildings:[/b] Sheet buildings are now serialized.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Reward Popup:[/b] The "New reward" popup now correctly displays when completing a region.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settlement Name Field Escape Key:[/b] The settlement name field will no longer revert its text if you press the Escape key.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zone Info Bar Fix:[/b] The zone info bar no longer shows a black empty box on claimed cities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expedition Preview Overlay:[/b] The black overlay on the preview expedition level will no longer disappear when selected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bubble Animation Freezes:[/b] Potential fixes for in-game bubble animations freezing have been implemented.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Legible Red Feature Text:[/b] Material for red feature text (seen when resources are low and on soldier combat) has been updated to be more legible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Legible UI Strap Elements:[/b] The strap elements holding info at the bottom of the UI have been updated to make content more legible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Watchtower Flag:[/b] Watchtower flag appearance and behavior have been updated for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sub-Settlement Pivots:[/b] Pivots for sub-settlements have been moved to prevent them from appearing in water.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leader Bubbles:[/b] Leader bubbles (Scout ability) now use a higher fidelity asset.[/p][/*][*][p][b]End-Game Reward Popup:[/b] The reward popup now shows again at end-game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expedition Asset Loading:[/b] An issue where lower quality assets would load on expeditions has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]
